title: Kafka — Broker & Consumers
description: Broker health, replication, throughput, latency, consumer lag and broker resources. Sources: Kafka JMX exporter (java agent), kafka-exporter, cAdvisor.

panels.title: Broker status
panels.description: Broker state 3 = RUNNING (JMX). No data = JMX endpoint unreachable.

panels.title: Under-replicated partitions
panels.description: Should be 0. >0 means followers are lagging behind the leader.

panels.title: Offline partitions
panels.description: Should be 0. >0 = partitions with no active leader (unavailable).

panels.title: Resources — CPU / Memory / Disk / Network (kafka container + JVM)
Disk
panels.description: Kafka log size is measured by the broker itself. Host disk usage: see the Services dashboard (Node).
